mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments (kind, sale_id, store_id, method, amount, tendered, status, reference, gateway_ref, reason, created_by) VALUES (#{kind}, #{saleId}, #{storeId}, #{method}, #{amount}, #{tendered}, #{status}, #{reference}, #{gatewayRef}, #{reason}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE sale_id = #{saleId} ORDER BY id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE sale_id = #{saleId} AND kind = #{kind} AND status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT method, kind, status, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total FROM payments WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY method, kind, status ORDER BY method, kind, status
